name: Laminar
short: Open-source LLM and agent observability with OTLP trace ingestion, full-text search, evals, datasets, and an AI trace debugger (Signals).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 GB data included, 7-day data access, 1 project, 1 seat, community support; no overage charges (hard cap).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 3 GB data included, then $2/GB; 30-day access, unlimited projects and seats, email support, $5 one-time Signals credit.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 10 GB data included, then $1.50/GB; 6-month access, unlimited projects and seats, Slack support.
